name: Typing Keys
description: A compact keyboard drawn in CSS whose keys sink and fill with water blue as you type on your own keyboard.

props.name: sound
props.description: Plays a short synthesised click on each key press, slightly lower toward the bottom rows.

props.name: showPreview
props.description: Shows the last few characters typed above the board, each floating up and fading.

props.name: onKey
props.type: (press: { code: string; key: string; source: "keyboard" | "pointer" }) => void
props.description: Called for every key press, from the physical keyboard while the board is on screen or from a click on a cap. Default behaviour is never prevented.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the outer element. The board scales to its width.
